ambiguities.source_text: Calculate how much Stock was ordered in these weeks
ambiguities.intent: An order triggered by the prior snapshot at quantity <= 10 arrives at the start of the current week, in amount 30 minus that prior quantity; otherwise receive zero.

ambiguities.source_text: Identify weeks where orders were placed for new stock: This occurs whenever the Quantity Available is 10 or less
ambiguities.ref:
qa_flags = inv_calc.assign(order_trigger=(inv_calc["Quantity Available"] <= 10))
orders_per_group = qa_flags.groupby(["Store", "Product ID"], as_index=False)["order_trigger"].sum()
ambiguities.intent: Count an order-trigger week whenever the current snapshot Quantity Available is <= 10, including the first and last observed weeks. This count determines order frequency.

ambiguities.source_text: Calculate the Quantity Sold each week, taking into consideration the new stock that has been ordered
ambiguities.intent: For each store/product in chronological order, weekly Sold = max(0, prior quantity + received order - current quantity).

Avg Order Frequency (i.e., if the Order Frequency is 2 then this would mean the Store is ordering once every 2 weeks on average)
ambiguities.intent: Avg Order Frequency = number of observed weekly snapshots / number of current-snapshot order triggers. This is observed weeks per order, not the mean of gaps between successive orders.

ambiguities.source_text: Round these values to 1 decimal place
ambiguities.ref:
summary["Avg Quantity Sold per Week"] = summary["Avg Quantity Sold per Week"].round(1)
summary["Avg Order Frequency"] = summary["Avg Order Frequency"].round(1)
ambiguities.intent: Round both average metrics to the nearest one decimal place. Total Quantity Sold is the exact sum of integer units; 12 and 12.0 are equivalent. CSV trailing zero padding is not required.
When no snapshot triggers an order, Avg Order Frequency is 0.0.
